evidence.notes: Local WebServiceCallout invokes the registered WebServiceMock.doInvoke implementation and observes response-map mutation.

source.content: public class MockSoapResponse implements WebServiceMock { public void doInvoke(Object stub, Object request, Map<String,Object> response, String endpoint, String soapAction, String requestName, String responseNS, String responseName, String responseType) { response.put('response_x', responseType + ':' + soapAction); } }

@isTest private class WebServiceMockCallbackFixtureTest { @isTest static void invokesRegisteredMock() { Test.setMock('WebServiceMock', new MockSoapResponse()); Map<String,Object> response = new Map<String,Object>(); WebServiceCallout.invoke(new Object(), 'request', response, new String[]{'https://example.test', 'soapAction', 'requestNS', 'requestName', 'responseNS', 'responseName', 'ResponseType'}); System.assertEquals('ResponseType:soapAction', response.get('response_x')); } }
